title: Ye Qing's Terms
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing took a blood-stained Jade Pendant from her sleeve—the only relic left when Chen Tianming disappeared twenty years ago—'He's still alive.'

text.content:
The third watch of the rat hour, Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Cliff.

The night wind cut like a blade, stinging faces with cold. Chen Ji stood beneath an old pine at the cliff's edge, his cyan robe billowing in the wind, yet his gaze remained still as dead water. His spiritual sense spread a hundred zhang in all directions, absorbing the aura of every rock and withered grass—habits forged by years of menial servitude, instincts drilled into him by the Tianji Record's repeated warnings.

'Holy Maiden Ye Qing, what a refined taste—summoning someone in the deep night. Aren't you afraid others might misunderstand?'

He didn't turn around, his voice lazy and casual, as if greeting an irrelevant passerby. But his right hand remained hidden in his sleeve, thumb pressed against the warm Fragment—for tonight's divination had been too vague, offering only one word: peril.

dialogue.content:
'Others?'

A light laugh came from behind, like an owl's low cry. Chen Ji felt his vision blur as a black figure darted to within three zhang, landing soundlessly, as if merging with the night itself. Tonight, Ye Qing had abandoned her Holy Maiden's ceremonial attire, wearing only a set of black combat attire that traced her fierce contours. A curved blade hung at her waist, gleaming with cold silver light.

'If I feared misunderstanding, I wouldn't have come.' She stopped five steps away, her face cold and stunning as frost under the moonlight. 'But Chen Junior, walking alone at night without any guards—is it that you're certain I won't strike, or do you have some other reliance?'

text.content:
Chen Ji finally turned around, his face wearing that usual rustic, honest smile, eyes curved into gentle crescents, looking utterly harmless.

'Holy Maiden Ye Qing, you're too kind.' He scratched the back of his head. 'I'm just a mere Menial Servant of Tianqing Sect—what guards could I possibly have?' His tone was light, but his mind was racing at lightning speed. The Tianji Record's warning tonight had been extremely cryptic—not about killing intent, but about... variables.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's gaze shifted slightly, a half-smile playing at her lips: 'Vegetables?'

She suddenly stepped forward, her aura turning sharp as a blade: 'Chen Ji, do you take me for a child? A Tianqing Sect Menial Servant who could survive three moves against Han Lie? Who could plant hidden agents right under Ling Yuan's nose? Who could make Xuanwu Sect's number one genius lose again and again?'

Her voice dropped to a whisper, yet each word cut like a knife: 'I've investigated you. Seven severe injuries near death across three years of entrance trials. Twelve instances of bullying by fellow disciples—yet you survived every single time, and every single time, you obtained fortuitous encounters in the most impossible places.'

She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, each word deliberate: 'In this world, no废物 can be this fortunate.'

text.content:
The night wind ceased abruptly.

Chen Ji's rustic smile remained unchanged, but his pupils contracted just slightly—for just an instant, then reverted to normal.

'Holy Maiden Ye Qing's research is truly meticulous.' He sighed, his tone carrying just the right amount of helpless resignation. 'Unfortunately, these were all coincidences. I'm simply hard to kill...' 

'Enough.'

Ye Qing cut him off, her voice suddenly turning cold: 'I didn't come to exchange riddles with you. Tonight, I summoned you for three matters.'

dialogue.content:
She raised her hand, extending one finger: 'First—the marriage alliance is a fraud.'

Chen Ji's brow lifted slightly, adopting a posture of attentive listening.

Ye Qing continued: 'The Demonic Holy Sect wants a marriage alliance with Tianqing Sect, ostensibly to ease relations between the orthodox and demonic paths—but in truth...' A mocking curve appeared at the corner of her lips. 'In truth, someone within the Holy Sect wishes to use this opportunity to infiltrate the Three Great Sects. And that certain 'someone' just happens to be my sworn enemy.'

She lowered her finger, her gaze deep and unfathomable: 'This marriage alliance was a scheme from the very beginning. Whether it succeeds or fails, I will be dragged into the vortex—so I need a chess piece to break the deadlock.'

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his eyes, as if digesting this information. After a moment, he raised his head, his honest face displaying a hint of confusion.

'Holy Maiden Ye Qing chooses me... does she think I'm easy to manipulate?'

Upon hearing this, Ye Qing actually let out a rare light laugh: 'Chen Ji, you and I both know clearly—a person who could survive three years under Ling Yuan's nose without being devoured is certainly no善茬.'

She stepped forward, closing the distance between them to three zhang: 'I choose you because you're intelligent enough, patient enough, and...' She paused, her gaze meaningful. 'Enough of a true废物.'

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's cooperation proposal and步步紧逼, Chen Ji needed to state his stance—whether to directly probe her cards or play along and stall for time.

choices.description: Pretend curiosity and inquire about the marriage alliance details, observing how much leverage Ye Qing is willing to reveal. Lower risk, but may appear overly eager.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Countered by Ye Qing's Counter-Probe

dialogue.content: 'Oh? The marriage alliance is a scheme...' Chen Ji scratched his head, his gaze flickering. 'Then Holy Maiden Ye Qing seeks me, wanting me to be that chess piece for breaking the deadlock? A mere Menial Servant like me, what help could I possibly provide?'

text.content: He deliberately lowered his posture, feigning a flattered appearance, but the corner of his eye remained fixed on Ye Qing's blade-wielding hand—that hand hung steadily at her side, flawless and without weakness.

choices.description: Expose Ye Qing's predicament, turning the tables and making her realize she also needs Chen Ji's cooperation. Display strategy, but may escalate antagonism.

dialogue.content: The rustic smile on Chen Ji's face gradually faded, replaced by a cold, tranquil calm: 'Holy Maiden Ye Qing, after saying all this, it seems you've forgotten one thing—you need me.'

text.content: He stepped forward, precisely filling the three-zhang gap between them: 'Your 'sworn enemy' wishes to drag you into the water through this marriage alliance, which means his power within the Holy Sect exceeds yours. You came to me, not because I'm intelligent, but because...' he paused meaningfully. 'You are easy to manipulate.'

choices.description: Show that one won't be used as a chess piece, forcefully refuse or propose one's own conditions. Highest risk, but also potentially highest reward.

dialogue.content: "Chess piece?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, his voice carrying a trace of indiscernible coldness. "Ye Holy Maiden, we're both intelligent people, so let's not beat around the bush. You want me to be the blade that breaks the deadlock—that's fine, but a blade has its demands too."

text.content: His gaze fell on the curved blade at Ye Qing's waist as he calmly said: "First, tell me what you can offer me."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's eyes flickered slightly, as if reassessing this "waste" before her.

After a moment, the smile at the corner of her lips deepened: "Interesting."

She wasn't angered by Chen Ji's counterattack; instead, her appreciation grew stronger: "The second matter—the demonic path's interior is far from united."

"The Holy Sect has three factions." Ye Qing raised three fingers. "The War Faction wants to crush the Three Great Sects and unify the cultivation world; the Peace Faction advocates coexistence with the righteous path, each keeping to their own domain; and my faction..."

She paused, her voice cooling: "The Independence Faction. We don't want to participate in the war between righteousness and demonic path—we only seek survival in the夹缝 between powers."

She lowered her hand, her gaze sharp as a blade: "The marriage alliance was the handiwork of the War Faction. They want to use the marriage as a pretense to infiltrate the Three Great Sects, gather intelligence, and cultivate hidden agents—then when the time is ripe, strike from within and sweep away the righteous path."

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his mind racing swiftly.

The demonic path's internal divisions—this was valuable intelligence indeed. But just this alone wasn't enough to make him risk cooperating with the demonic path's Holy Maiden.

"What about the third matter?" He raised his head, his tone unruffled.

Ye Qing didn't answer immediately. She quietly regarded Chen Ji, moonlight flowing in her eyes, reflecting a complex emotion.

That emotion flashed past, then was replaced by cold elegance.

"The third matter..." Her voice suddenly dropped lower, "...involves you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's heart trembled imperceptibly, yet his expression remained unmoved.

"Involves me?" He tilted his head slightly. "What business could a servant disciple like me have with the demonic path's Holy Maiden?"

Ye Qing stared into his eyes, word by word: "Chen Ji—your real name is not Chen Ji."

A sudden gust of mountain wind arose, scattering countless withered leaves across the sky.

"Your original name was Chen Tianming, the direct bloodline of the Chen family from the Heavenly Fate Pavilion—the clan that was destroyed twenty years ago."

text.content:
In that moment, Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat.

Chen Tianming.

This was a name even he himself didn't know. Master Mo had never mentioned it, nor did he have any memory of this past—all he knew was that he was an orphan, an abandoned infant picked up by his master from among the dead.

But he let no emotion show on his face.

"Ye Holy Maiden is joking." He smiled, his tone relaxed. "Chen Tianming? Never heard of him. I'm just an ordinary servant—where would I get some great family's bloodline?"

dialogue.content:
"Is that so?"

Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, closing the distance until they could almost feel each other's breath. She drew a yellowed letter from her sleeve, upon which a portrait was painted.

The painting depicted a child around three years old, with delicate features and a faint cinnabar mole between their brows.

"On the night the Heavenly Fate Pavilion was destroyed, someone secretly smuggled out an infant, who passed through many hands and ended up at the Tianqing Sect, becoming a servant disciple." Ye Qing's gaze fell on Chen Ji's brow center. "That mole on your brow center is identical to the person in the painting."

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at that portrait, his heart surging with immense waves.

The mole at his brow center—he had always thought it was merely an ordinary birthmark. Master Mo had never explained it, and he had never asked. But if what Ye Qing said was true...

He took a deep breath, pressing all his emotions into the depths of his heart.

"Even if I am Chen Tianming, so what?" He raised his head, his gaze calm. "That was all twenty years ago—what does it have to do with tonight's negotiations?"

Ye Qing withdrew the letter, her tone cold: "Because the true mastermind behind the Heavenly Fate Pavilion's destruction lies within the Three Great Sects."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing dropped a bombshell about Chen Ji's身世—the true mastermind behind the Heavenly Fate Pavilion's destruction lies within the Three Great Sects. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Inquire about the truth of the destruction
choices.description: Directly inquire about the details of the Heavenly Fate Pavilion's destruction and the identity of the mastermind behind it. Shows concern for one's身世, but may expose weaknesses.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's fingers curled slightly, yet his voice remained calm: "The mastermind behind the destruction? Since Ye Holy Maiden has such intelligence, you might as well speak plainly."

text.content: He paused, a self-mocking弧度 curling at the corner of his lips: "After all, I've ended up like this anyway—what good would knowing the truth do? It would just give me another reason to hate."

choices.description: Reveal nothing, continue letting Ye Qing speak, see what other trump cards she holds. Shows深度, but may miss the opportunity to inquire.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, you are well-informed." Chen Ji said calmly, "But what intrigues me more is——why are you telling me all this?"

text.content: His gaze was calm as still water, betraying not the slightest ripple: "You and I are strangers, with no grievance between us. You bring me intelligence, bring me my origins——I don't believe such blessings fall from the heavens."

choices.description: Directly expose that Ye Qing's revelations must have ulterior motives, refusing to accept one-sided intelligence. Medium risk, may provoke key information.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji let out a soft laugh: "Ye Qing, we are both chess players here. You've gone to such great lengths to investigate my background——surely not for old times' sake?"

text.content: With hands clasped behind his back, his tone carried a hint of playfulness: "Go ahead, tell me what you want me to do, and what you can offer me? Get it straight, then we can discuss cooperation."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji, a flash of appreciation flickering in her eyes.

"Good." She nodded. "Straightforward. Then I'll be direct too——I need you to sabotage this marriage alliance. In return, I will tell you everything I know about the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion."

She paused, her voice dropping lower: "Including... the final whereabouts of your father, Chen Tiaming."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

Father?

"Twenty years ago when the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion was annihilated, the official story blamed the Demonic Path." Ye Qing's voice was平静得近乎残忍, "But your father——Chen Tiaming——did not die."

She drew a bloodstained jade pendant from her sleeve, glowing faintly in the moonlight. An ancient rune was carved upon it, bearing a striking resemblance to the patterns on the fragment in Chen Ji's possession.

"This is evidence from the Holy Sect's archives. Twenty years ago, someone witnessed a man who looked exactly like Chen Tiaming, sealed in the deepest depths of the Northern Wasteland Forbidden Land."

Her gaze was like a blade, piercing directly at Chen Ji: "He is still alive——or rather, has been imprisoned for twenty years."

text.content:
Mountain winds howled, ruffling Chen Ji's azure robes.

He stared at the bloodstained jade pendant, emotions churning within him beyond words. Twenty years——he had been trampled as waste for twenty years, treated as insignificant by all for twenty years. And his father, perhaps trapped in some sunless place, struggling desperately for twenty years.

But on his face remained that unruffled expression.

"Ye Qing." He spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm, "What is it that you want?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing withdrew the jade pendant, a faint smile curving her lips.

"Straightforward." She nodded approvingly. "My condition is simple——sabotage the marriage alliance, let the war faction's plans fail. In return, I will help you find out how to enter the Northern Wasteland Forbidden Land, and... your father's exact location."

She stepped forward, closing the distance between them to just one zhang: "How does this deal seem to you?"

Under the moonlight, her eyes reflected Chen Ji's silhouette, deep and complex.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing has thrown down her final condition——exchange sabotaging the marriage alliance for information about his father Chen Tiaming. This is a chip impossible to refuse. How should Chen Ji respond?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "Deal."

text.content: He extended his hand, facing Ye Qing from afar: "But I have one thing to say first——I do the work, I don't take sides. Your vendetta, you settle yourself. I only exist to... stir up trouble."

choices.description: Point out the inequality of this exchange, demanding more guarantees and intelligence before agreeing. Display negotiating skills, but may arouse Ye Qing's suspicion.

dialogue.content: "Cooperation is possible." Chen Ji said calmly, "But Holy Lady Ye, all you've given me is intelligence. I have nothing."

text.content: He pointed at himself: "I'm just a mere servant disciple. For someone like me, sabotaging a marriage alliance is a life-or-death situation. Holy Lady Ye, you should at least give me a deposit, right?"

choices.text: Test how much she is willing to offer
choices.description: Pretend to hesitate, probe Ye Qing's bottom line, see what other cards she will reveal. High reward, but may seem not straightforward enough.
choices.visible_reward: See through all of Ye Qing's cards

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. He looked up at the night sky, as if in contemplation.

"Holy Lady Ye." After a long while, he finally spoke, "I understand everything you've said, but this deal..."

text.content: He withdrew his gaze and looked at Ye Qing: "It's too big. I need time to consider."

Ye Qing watched Chen Ji silently, her gaze deep and unfathomable.

Under the moonlight, she suddenly let out a cold laugh. That laughter was cold as ice, yet carried an inexplicable complexity.

"Chen Ji, you're more cautious than I imagined." She put away the jade pendant. "Very well, tonight's words have been enough. In three days, I will send someone with the specific arrangements for the marriage alliance—at that time, you can give me your answer."

She turned around, her black combat attire rustling in the wind.

"Oh, by the way." After taking a few steps, she suddenly stopped. "That Su Qingyao by your side is quite interesting. She's been investigating you quite deeply... Be careful, don't let the duck slip away from your hands."

With those words, her figure vanished like a specter into the night.

Silence returned to the cliff.

Chen Ji stood alone under the old pine tree, the night wind billowing his cyan robe. His right hand remained hidden in his sleeve, fingertips pressed against the warm fragment.

The warning from the Tianji Record tonight had finally come to fruition at this moment.

The variable—Ye Qing was the variable.

He slowly took out the fragment and gazed at the blurry characters under the moonlight. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul on the first page trembled slightly, as if wanting to speak, yet fell silent.

"Master." Chen Ji spoke softly, "Is Chen Tianming... my father?"

The remnant soul remained silent for a long time, finally sending out a desolate sigh, but did not answer.

Chen Ji did not press further. He put the fragment back into his sleeve, turned and walked toward the mountain, his footsteps steady, his expression calm.

Whether what Ye Qing said was true or false—on this road, he had no room for retreat.

Chen Ji took out the blood-stained jade pendant from his sleeve, examining it carefully under the moonlight. The ancient runes on the jade pendant were indeed from the same source as the patterns on the Tianji Record fragment—this was no coincidence.

His fingers gently traced over those mottled bloodstains, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. What happened that night twenty years ago? Why was his father imprisoned? Who was the true culprit behind the destruction of the Heavenly Celestial Pavilion...

Above the cliff, the night wind whimpered.

Chen Ji put the jade pendant into his chest, his gaze falling on the distant dark horizon. Su Qingyao's warning, Ye Qing's conditions, Mo Xiansheng's silence—all the clues pointed in one direction: the Northern Wasteland Forbidden Grounds.

He suddenly remembered something Mo Xiansheng once said: "The price of the Tianji Record was never just the Heavenly Fate Value."

Perhaps there were more things he did not yet know.
